s: A company has a few AWS accounts for development and wants to move its production application to AWS. The company needs to enforce Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) encryption at rest current production accounts and future production accounts only. The company needs a solution that includes built-in blueprints and guardrails. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)
o: Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy AWS Config rules on production accounts.
Create a new AWS Control Tower landing zone in an existing developer account. Create OUs for accounts. Add production and development accounts to production and development OUs, respectively.
Create a new AWS Control Tower landing zone in the company's management account. Add production and development accounts to production and development OUs. respectively.
Invite existing accounts to join the organization in AWS Organizations. Create SCPs to ensure compliance.
Create a guardrail from the management account to detect EBS encryption.
Create a guardrail for the production OU to detect EBS encryption.
e: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/controls.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/strongly-recommended controls. html#ebs-enable-encryption AWS is now transitioning the previous term 'guardrail' new term 'control'.

w.y: The deciding words are 'built-in blueprints and guardrails' and 'current and future production accounts only'. AWS Control Tower in the management account provides the landing zone, existing accounts are brought into the organization, and a detective control on the production OU checks EBS encryption only for production.

o.A: StackSets with Config rules work but are not Control Tower's built-in blueprints and guardrails.
o.B: A Control Tower landing zone must be set up from the organization's management account, not a developer account.
o.C: Correct: Control Tower in the management account with production and development OUs gives blueprints and guardrails.
o.D: Correct: existing accounts must join the organization before Control Tower can govern them.
o.E: A control applied from the management account broadly would also hit development accounts, which the question excludes.
o.F: Correct: enabling the EBS encryption control on the production OU covers current and future production accounts only.
